reading: Senior Iranian officials recently gathered for the funeral of an influential ayatollah, drawing international attention.
However, Iran's supreme leader was notably absent from this important public event, sparking various discussions.
This significant absence has led to numerous speculations among political observers and analysts.
Separately, Mojtaba Khamenei, who is a prominent figure in Iran, has not been seen publicly for some time.
His disappearance began following an attack that tragically killed his father, a significant event.
This incident occurred at the very outset of a major conflict involving the US and Israel in relation to Iran.
The ongoing conflict has significantly impacted the political landscape and regional stability.
Such unusual public absences of key individuals often suggest underlying shifts or important internal events within a government.
Many are observing closely for any further official announcements or new developments regarding the situation.
The complex situation highlights the deep political complexities and continued tensions within the Middle East.

vocabulary.definition: A high-ranking cleric in the Shia Islamic religious hierarchy, often with significant religious and political influence.
The beginning or start of something, especially a process or event.
A serious disagreement or argument, often involving prolonged fighting or hostility between groups or nations.
caused a person or animal to die
to a degree that is important or noticeable
still happening or lasting without stopping
including someone or something as part of an event
people who watch events carefully and report what they notice

entries.ja: シーア派イスラム教の宗教的階層において高位の聖職者で、しばしば重要な宗教的および政治的影響力を持つ人。
entries.ko: 시아 이슬람교의 종교적 계층에서 높은 직위를 가진 성직자로, 종종 중요한 종교적 및 정치적 영향력을 행사합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 什叶派伊斯兰教宗教等级制度中的高级教士，通常具有重要的宗教和政治影响力。
entries.es: Un clérigo de alto rango en la jerarquía religiosa islámica chiita, que a menudo posee una influencia religiosa y política significativa.
entries.pt-BR: Um clérigo de alto escalão na hierarquia religiosa islâmica xiita, que frequentemente possui significativa influência religiosa e política.

entries.ja: 何か、特に過程や出来事の始まり。
entries.ko: 어떤 일, 특히 과정이나 사건의 시작 또는 처음.
entries.zh-Hans: 某事，特别是某个过程或事件的开端或开始。
entries.es: El comienzo o inicio de algo, especialmente de un proceso o evento.
entries.pt-BR: O começo ou início de algo, especialmente de um processo ou evento.

entries.ja: 深刻な意見の相違や議論で、しばしば集団や国家間の長期にわたる戦闘や敵意を伴うもの。
entries.ko: 심각한 의견 불일치나 논쟁으로, 종종 집단이나 국가 간의 장기간에 걸친 싸움이나 적대감을 포함합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 严重的意见分歧或争论，通常涉及团体或国家之间长期的战斗或敌意。
entries.es: Un desacuerdo o discusión grave, que a menudo implica luchas prolongadas u hostilidad entre grupos o naciones.
entries.pt-BR: Um desacordo ou discussão séria, que frequentemente envolve combates prolongados ou hostilidad entre grupos ou nações.

entries.es: Hacer que una persona o un animal muera.
entries.pt-BR: Fez com que uma pessoa ou animal morresse.

entries.ja: 重要であるか、注目に値する程度に。
entries.zh-Hans: 达到重要或值得注意的程度。
entries.es: En un grado que es importante o perceptible.
entries.pt-BR: Em um grau que é importante ou notável.

entries.ja: 止まることなく、まだ続いているか、持続している。
entries.zh-Hans: 仍在发生或持续而没有停止。
entries.es: Que sigue ocurriendo o durando sin detenerse.
entries.pt-BR: Que ainda está acontecendo ou durando sem parar.

entries.ja: 出来事の一部として誰かや何かを含めること。
entries.ko: 어떤 사건의 일부로 누군가나 무언가를 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某人或某事作为某个事件的一部分包含在内。
entries.es: Incluir a alguien o algo como parte de un evento.
entries.pt-BR: Incluir alguém ou algo como parte de um evento.

entries.ja: 出来事を注意深く観察し、気づいたことを報告する人々。
entries.ko: 사건을 주의 깊게 지켜보고 자신이 알아차린 것을 보고하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 仔细观察事件并报告他们所注意到的人。
entries.es: Personas que observan eventos cuidadosamente y reportan lo que notan.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que observam eventos cuidadosamente e relatam o que percebem.
